Marco: RCA published for the eviction surge incident: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2109998888-eviction
Marco: Short summary: a combination of an aggressive cache eviction heuristic and a recent rollout of a batching optimization caused synchronized KV-cache flushes under sudden spikes. Result: ~20m of elevated tail latency and increased retry traffic.
Marco: Full write-up includes timeline, config diffs, synthetic repro, and anonymized samples. Please review owners + timeline.
Marco: Key action items (owners + due dates):
- Aileen 1 1: revert batching heuristic change to safe default and add feature-flag gating 1 target 2026-04-02
- Sam 1: implement a pre-eviction signal in telemetry and a dashboard alert (prefetch hit ratio < 0.6) 1 target 2026-03-29
- Priya 1: draft customer comms + support detection steps for impacted accounts 1 target 2026-03-30
Marco: Also added an integration test for staggered cache refresh and a small canary plan (us-east-1 -> us-west-2). Please comment if ownership needs changing.
Aileen: I opened PR #1204 to add feature flag + safe default for batching. Included unit tests. Will link to RCA.
Sam: I'll add the alert and a dashboard mock. Agree to add a 10-minute early-warning tier before eviction threshold.
Alert metric proposal: "kv_prefetch_hit_ratio" and "staging_eviction_rate".
Priya: I'll draft the external-facing note once Aileen's revert is staged. Also adding a support playbook snippet in the doc.
AlertBot: Incident logged: INC-9001 1 https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-9001
Marco: Planning a quick 20-min checkpoint tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm merges and canary parameters. Invite: https://calendar.internal/meet/eviction-check
Aileen: +1, will present PR and tests.
Sam: +1, will show dashboards.
Priya: +1, will bring the comms draft.
Marco: Thanks all. If you can't attend, leave a note in the doc and mark your action complete when done. :thumbsup:
